sentences.en: With the school year ending, educators and parents all over the country are taking stock of the earthquake that is AI in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 随着学年结束，全国各地的教育工作者和家长们都在审视人工智能进入课堂所带来的震荡。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Natasha Singer talks about the year that reshaped American classrooms
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事娜塔莎·辛格将讲述这一重塑美国课堂的年份，

sentences.en: and how one dedicated teacher helped his students chart their own path into an uncertain future.
sentences.zh: 以及一位敬业的老师如何帮助学生在充满不确定的未来中规划自己的道路。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月17日，星期三。

sentences.en: Natasha Singer, welcome back to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎·辛格，欢迎回到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我，瑞秋。

sentences.en: So the school year is done for most students across the country, and it's been a really contentious year when it comes to one topic in particular, which is AI in the classroom,
sentences.zh: 全国大部分学生的学年已经结束了，而这一年里，有一个话题引发了极大的争议，那就是人工智能进课堂，

sentences.en: something that you have been covering.
sentences.zh: 这也是你一直在报道的内容。

sentences.en: Can you summarize for us what the fight is over specifically, and when did it really get started?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们总结一下这场争论的具体焦点是什么，以及它是从什么时候开始的吗？

sentences.en: You know, Rachel, I've been covering tech in schools and tech industry, influence in schools for the New York Times for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 你知道，瑞秋，我为《纽约时报》报道学校科技和科技行业对学校的影响已经超过十年了。

sentences.en: And I've never seen the kind of parent backlash about school tech that we're seeing.
sentences.zh: 但我从未见过家长对学校科技有如此强烈的抵触情绪。

sentences.en: And particularly, as you pointed out, AI is becoming the new flashpoint.
sentences.zh: 正如你所指出的，人工智能正成为新的矛盾爆发点。

sentences.en: And I think that it's partly because of the context.
sentences.zh: 我认为这部分是因为当前的背景。

sentences.en: First of all, there are massive concerns about cheating.
sentences.zh: 首先，人们对作弊有着巨大的担忧。

sentences.en: Students tell me they're sitting in the front row of class and the kids in the back row have got their Chromebooks open.
sentences.zh: 学生们告诉我，他们坐在教室前排，而坐在后排的孩子们正开着Chromebook。

sentences.en: And whenever a teacher asks a question, the kids in the back are looking up the answers on Gemini or ChatGPT.
sentences.zh: 每当老师提问时，后排的孩子们就会在Gemini或ChatGPT上搜索答案。

sentences.en: And if they get called on, they're just reading the AI answers.
sentences.zh: 如果被点名回答，他们就直接读出AI给出的答案。

sentences.en: And so there are all these concerns that these AI tools could pose serious risk to kids learning, to kids critical thinking.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们普遍担心这些AI工具会对孩子们的学习和批判性思维能力构成严重威胁。

sentences.en: And so that's part of what the fight is about.
sentences.zh: 这就是争论的一部分原因。

sentences.en: And at the same time, you're getting this massive push from tech companies like Google and Microsoft and OpenAI to get their chatbots into schools.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，谷歌、微软和OpenAI等科技公司正在大力推动将他们的聊天机器人引入学校。

sentences.en: And you're also seeing the White House pushing for AI education.
sentences.zh: 你也能看到白宫正在推动人工智能教育。

sentences.en: This next executive order relates to artificial intelligence education, sir.
sentences.zh: 下一项行政命令与人工智能教育有关，先生。

sentences.en: The White House issued this executive order on AI education toward the end of the last school year.
sentences.zh: 白宫在上个学年结束时发布了这项关于人工智能教育的行政命令。

sentences.en: And it was called Advancing AI Education for American Youth.
sentences.zh: 它被称为《推进美国青少年的AI教育》。

sentences.en: That's a big deal because AI is where it seems to be at.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大，因为人工智能似乎就是当下的核心趋势。

sentences.en: We have literally trillions of dollars being invested in AI.
sentences.zh: 我们有数万亿美元的资金投入到了人工智能领域。

sentences.en: The Trump White House was saying if America wants to remain on the cutting edge, then we need kids to learn how to use these AI tools.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府当时表示，如果美国想要保持领先地位，就需要让孩子们学会使用这些AI工具。

sentences.en: AI is the way to the future.

sentences.zh: 现在，你可能会想，这有什么大不了的？

sentences.zh: 他们看了一部电影的场景，导演用人工智能生成了一场爆炸，他们讨论了，比如，

sentences.en: And when we talked to students from the class, they weren't naive about the potential impacts of the technology,

sentences.en: And Anna asked them broadly about what they had hoped to get out of the AI literacy class and how they thought about AI now.
sentences.zh: 安娜广泛地询问了他们希望从这门人工智能素养课中获得什么，以及他们现在如何看待人工智能。

sentences.en: I decided to sign up for this class because I actually did an internship last year, and I saw how there was a lot of AI co-pilots that hooked in, like, business databases.
sentences.zh: 我决定报名参加这门课，因为我去年确实做过一次实习，我看到了很多人工智能副驾驶是如何接入商业数据库的。

sentences.en: So I felt like AI isn't going to go nowhere, so it's better for me to learn it now so I will be more, like, aware and know how to work AI in my future.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉人工智能不会消失，所以我现在学习它更好，这样我将来会更了解它，知道如何使用人工智能。

sentences.en: So I just wanted a better understanding of how AI can help me in my thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想更好地了解人工智能如何帮助我的思考。

sentences.en: Like going throughout this class,
sentences.zh: 就像在这门课的学习过程中，

sentences.en: it kind of made me realize that I have to approach AI with a certain purpose in mind instead of just mindlessly asking a general question because then AI will kind of drive me and I won't drive it.
sentences.zh: 这让我意识到，我必须带着明确的目的去使用人工智能，而不是漫无目的地提出笼统的问题，否则就会变成人工智能在“驾驭”我，而不是我在驾驭它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What did you think about AI before you started this class?
sentences.zh: 在上这门课之前，你是怎么看待人工智能的？

sentences.en: To me, I think the misconception that I had is AI kind of has the answers to everything because I had some very specific tasks that I was working on.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我之前的误区是认为人工智能什么问题都能解决，因为我当时手头有一些非常具体的任务。

sentences.en: And if I wasn't specific, giving the AI context or like being straightforward with what I needed it for, it wasn't as accurate or efficient as I hoped it was going to be.
sentences.zh: 如果我不够具体，不给人工智能提供背景信息，或者不直接说明我的需求，它的回答就不会像我预期的那样准确或高效。

sentences.en: And it just showed me that I had to put a lot more effort into my own personal thinking and taking the initiative on my own versus solely relying on AI in places that I probably shouldn't have solely been relying on it for.
sentences.zh: 这让我明白，我必须在自己的思考上投入更多精力，主动去掌控，而不是在某些本不该完全依赖人工智能的地方过度依赖它。

sentences.en: When you look back on this course, do you have favorite lessons?
sentences.zh: 回望这门课程，你有什么喜欢的课程内容吗？

sentences.en: Any memories that, you know, you had a light bulb moment or like were funny or silly?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么让你灵光一现，或者觉得有趣、好玩的记忆？

sentences.en: I would say probably the first class.
sentences.zh: 我觉得应该是第一节课吧。

sentences.en: We had an example chart of like, how are you a driver?
sentences.zh: 我们当时有一个示例图表，讲的是“你如何成为驾驶者？”

sentences.en: How are you a passenger?
sentences.zh: “你如何成为乘客？”

sentences.en: And I was like, I really sat back and realized I was like, Spotify has an AI like DJ.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的坐下来反思了一下，意识到 Spotify 有个 AI DJ 功能。

sentences.en: And I'm always listening to the AI DJ.
sentences.zh: 我总是听那个 AI DJ。

sentences.en: It plays all of my favorite music.
sentences.zh: 它会播放我所有喜欢的音乐。

sentences.en: And I was like, that's AI unconsciously driving me because I'm not picking the music.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，那是人工智能在无意识地“驾驶”我，因为我根本没在选歌。

sentences.en: I'm just listening to whatever it generates.
sentences.zh: 我只是在听它生成的内容。

sentences.en: And I was, it was funny because I was just like, I feel like I have a good understanding of AI.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为我本来觉得自己对人工智能挺了解的。

sentences.en: But this idea of like being a driver wasn't really something I ever thought of.
sentences.zh: 但“驾驶者”这个概念，我以前从未想过。

sentences.en: Did you change how you listen to music?
sentences.zh: 你现在听音乐的方式改变了吗？

sentences.en: Like, do you still use AI DJ?
sentences.zh: 比如，你还在用 AI DJ 吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 用。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I try to like be more specific.
sentences.zh: 我试着更具体一点。

sentences.en: Like, if I don't like the song, I'll skip it now.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我不喜欢这首歌，我现在会跳过它。

sentences.en: Before, I just let it used to go on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 以前，我只会任由它一直播下去。

sentences.en: But, you know, I'm trying to get better.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，我正在努力改进。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're trying to say, like, if it's going to pick music for me, it should be Straight Hits.
sentences.zh: 你是想说，如果它要为我选歌，那它就得选出最棒的曲目。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm kind of curious, like, before this class, like, I feel like I see a lot of people in my life using AI, including my parents.
sentences.zh: 我有点好奇，在上这门课之前，我发现我生活中很多人都在用人工智能，包括我的父母。

sentences.en: Have your parents used AI?
sentences.zh: 你父母用过人工智能吗？

sentences.en: And, like, what is that like?
sentences.zh: 那是什么样的体验？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 用过。

sentences.en: So, recently, I went on vacation with my mom.
sentences.zh: 最近我和我妈去度假。

sentences.en: And our whole itinerary when we were in Puerto Rico was completely chat-GBT generated.
sentences.zh: 我们在波多黎各的整个行程完全是 ChatGPT 生成的。

sentences.en: But my mom was like, this saved her so much time.
sentences.zh: 但我妈觉得这帮她节省了大量时间。

sentences.en: And most of the places we went to were actually pretty good.
sentences.zh: 而且我们去的大多数地方其实都还不错。

sentences.en: But I would say the issue with both of my parents is they cannot tell us some things AI generated.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我父母的问题在于，他们分辨不出哪些内容是人工智能生成的。

sentences.en: And even it will say at the bottom, like, may contain AI generated media.
sentences.zh: 即使页面底部写着“可能包含人工智能生成的内容”。

sentences.en: And they're just like, well, how can you tell?
sentences.zh: 他们还是会问：“这怎么分辨出来啊？”

sentences.en: And I'm just like, yeah, this is going to be a problem, I feel like, in the future.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，这在未来可能会是个问题。

sentences.en: It's here to stay, so you might as well start learning it, kind of like what you were saying.
sentences.zh: 它已经普及了，所以你最好还是开始学习它，就像你刚才说的那样。

sentences.en: You two, anything with your parents?
sentences.zh: 你们两位呢，你们父母的情况如何？

sentences.en: So my dad is mostly a call type of person.
sentences.zh: 我爸基本上是个喜欢打电话的人。

sentences.en: Like, he'll call me instead of text me.
sentences.zh: 他宁愿给我打电话也不发短信。

sentences.en: but recently he's been texting me and using ChadGBT.
sentences.zh: 但最近他开始给我发短信，而且在用 ChatGPT。

sentences.en: How can you tell?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看出来的？

sentences.en: I can tell because that is not the way he talks at all.
sentences.zh: 我能看出来，因为他说话根本不是那个语气。

sentences.en: The times he does text me, it's only like one word short answers and now all of a sudden I'm getting this long paragraph of like advanced words.
sentences.zh: 他以前给我发短信，只会回一两个字的短句，现在突然给我发一大段用词高级的文字。

sentences.en: Not to say he doesn't know them, but that's not him.
sentences.zh: 并不是说他不懂这些词，但这根本不是他。

sentences.en: He just doesn't typically write novels.
sentences.zh: 他平时根本不写长篇大论。

sentences.en: Yeah, he does not write like that at all.
sentences.zh: 没错，他绝对不会那样写。

sentences.en: And it really caught me off guard and I asked him about it And he said, yeah, ChadGBT really helps me formulate my grammar.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我措手不及，我问了他，他说：“是啊，ChatGPT 确实帮我润色了语法。”

sentences.en: And I was telling him that I want to hear what you have to say, not ChadGBT.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我想听的是你的想法，而不是 ChatGPT 的。

sentences.en: So we talked about it for a bit, and he kind of understood where I was coming from.
sentences.zh: 所以我们聊了一会儿，他大概理解了我的意思。

sentences.en: That's a big task as your family ambassador for AI.
sentences.zh: 作为家里的“人工智能大使”，这任务可不轻啊。

sentences.en: Well, they say to themselves, like, I'm growing up in this time of AI, so I feel like it's kind of up to me.
sentences.zh: 他们会对自己说，我是在人工智能时代长大的，所以我觉得这得靠我。

sentences.en: So the students have taken on the roles of teachers.
sentences.zh: 所以学生们承担起了老师的角色。

sentences.en: They're teaching their parents about AI and how to use AI responsibly.
sentences.zh: 他们在教父母关于人工智能的知识，以及如何负责任地使用它。

sentences.en: Well, thank you guys so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: And thank you for letting me sit in on class.
sentences.zh: 也谢谢你们让我旁听这门课。

sentences.en: I enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我很享受。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: But Natasha, given just how fast all this AI technology is evolving, I mean, they're coming out with like new versions of chat GBT, it feels like every few weeks at this point.
sentences.zh: 但是娜塔莎，考虑到人工智能技术的发展速度如此之快，我是说，现在感觉每隔几周就会推出新版本的 ChatGPT。

sentences.en: What are the chances that whatever these kids learn this semester would be outdated by the next school year?
sentences.zh: 这些孩子这学期学到的东西，到下个学年会不会就过时了？

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: But I think what's fascinating about these teachers is they're trying to get students to think deeply about its implications for society.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这些老师最迷人的地方在于，他们试图让学生深入思考人工智能对社会的意义。

sentences.en: Not just how to use it.
sentences.zh: 而不仅仅是如何使用它。

sentences.en: And the questioning skills that they're learning can be applied to any technology, whether it's social media or like upcoming quantum technology.
sentences.zh: 他们学到的提问技巧可以应用于任何技术，无论是社交媒体还是即将到来的量子技术。

sentences.en: And so I think of this not so much as AI literacy, as AI civics.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这不仅仅是人工智能素养，更是人工智能公民教育。

sentences.en: It's a civics class.
sentences.zh: 这是一门公民课。

sentences.en: And so as a final project, the students got up and they presented a kind of declaration of independence about this technology.
sentences.zh: 作为期末项目，学生们站起来发表了一份关于这项技术的“独立宣言”。

sentences.en: that artificial intelligence is a tool created to expand human potential
sentences.zh: 人工智能是为拓展人类潜能而创造的工具。

sentences.en: AI is meant to be a tool to help people instead of replacing human thinking To foster personal harmony, we seek a personal connection with technology
sentences.zh: 人工智能旨在成为帮助人类的工具，而非取代人类的思考；为了促进个人和谐，我们寻求与技术建立个人联系。

sentences.en: that serves to enhance the human experience without replacing it That creativity is lost whenever convenience becomes more important than growth
sentences.zh: 它旨在增强人类体验而非取代它；当便利性变得比成长更重要时，创造力就会丧失。

sentences.en: and that true learning still demands struggle, reflection, and creativity
sentences.zh: 真正的学习依然需要挣扎、反思和创造力。

sentences.en: AI should be viewed as an extension for humanity, designed to unlock solutions for critical challenges.
sentences.zh: 人工智能应被视为人类的延伸，旨在为关键挑战解锁解决方案。

sentences.en: Whenever AI begins to diminish honesty or human connection, we have the responsibility to limit its use and to question its influence.
sentences.zh: 每当人工智能开始削弱诚实或人际联系时，我们就有责任限制其使用并质疑其影响。

sentences.en: Educational institutions may authorize the usage of artificial intelligence, provided it remains a tool of support and never a surrogate for the educator.
sentences.zh: 教育机构可以授权使用人工智能，前提是它必须保持为辅助工具，绝不能成为教育者的替代品。

sentences.en: In conclusion, we stand firm against the surrender of our autonomy.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们坚定反对放弃我们的自主权。

sentences.en: We assert our role as the architects of the future.
sentences.zh: 我们主张自己作为未来建筑师的角色。

sentences.en: Thank you for a great semester.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们度过了一个很棒的学期。

sentences.en: We hadn't ever taught this class before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前从未教过这门课。

sentences.en: It never existed before at the school.
sentences.zh: 它以前在学校里从未存在过。

sentences.en: And thanks to you, I think it's become a part of the future here and elsewhere, maybe.
sentences.zh: 多亏了你们，我想它已经成为这里乃至其他地方未来的一部分了。

sentences.en: When you think of what parents are concerned about, that there's so much tech in schools,
sentences.zh: 当你想到家长们担心学校里有太多科技产品时，

sentences.en: that it is rotting kids' brains and bamboozling them, and they won't be able to think critically.
sentences.zh: 担心它会腐蚀孩子的大脑，把他们搞得晕头转向，导致他们无法进行批判性思考，

sentences.en: Like, here you have 12th graders who arrived at a place where they're excited about AI.
sentences.zh: 而在这里，你看到的是一群对人工智能感到兴奋的 12 年级学生。

sentences.en: They want to use the tools in ways that will benefit them.
sentences.zh: 他们想以对自己有利的方式使用这些工具。

sentences.en: They have specific ideas about what uses that might be, but they also know that they are dealing with a product and they don't want to have a product-driven future.
sentences.zh: 他们对这些工具的具体用途有自己的想法，但他们也知道自己是在处理一种产品，他们不希望拥有一个由产品驱动的未来。

sentences.en: They want to have a human-driven future.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一个由人类驱动的未来。

sentences.en: And I think that that's like an amazing outcome for parents who are concerned about the overuse of tech in schools.
sentences.zh: 对于那些担心学校过度使用科技产品的家长来说，我认为这是一个了不起的成果。

sentences.en: Well, to your point, Natasha, what people are worried about with technology is so existential, right?
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎，说到你的观点，人们对技术的担忧是非常存在主义的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, it's really important how we educate kids.
sentences.zh: 我们如何教育孩子确实非常重要。

sentences.en: But what is the world that we are educating them for?
sentences.zh: 但我们到底是在为什么样的世界教育他们呢？

sentences.en: Because what this one teacher is doing, even if it does work and it gets students to think critically and use these tools better,
sentences.zh: 因为这位老师所做的，即使确实有效，能让学生进行批判性思考并更好地使用这些工具，

sentences.en: that feels very out of scale with the advances this technology is making in basically every other sector of our lives.
sentences.zh: 但与这项技术在我们生活几乎所有其他领域取得的进步相比，这显得有些不成比例。

sentences.en: Like, this feels a little bit like a David and Goliath story.
sentences.zh: 这感觉有点像“大卫与歌利亚”的故事。

sentences.en: So I think you're picking up something that's really important.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为你捕捉到了非常重要的东西。

sentences.en: We all know there's a massive,
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，

sentences.en: massive power imbalance between trillion-dollar tech giants pushing schools to train kids on their AI tools and the durable critical thinking skills that teachers like Scott and Mike believe are in the best interests of kids.
sentences.zh: 在万亿级科技巨头推动学校培训孩子使用其人工智能工具，与斯科特和迈克等老师认为对孩子最有利的持久批判性思维技能之间，存在着巨大的权力失衡。

sentences.en: But I think it's part of a much bigger thing that's happening where we're questioning what we want the world to look like.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这是正在发生的一件更宏大事情的一部分，我们正在质疑我们希望世界变成什么样子。

sentences.en: I'm visiting schools all the time, and I think this grassroots teacher movement for AI civics is much bigger than the one classroom in the one school we visited.
sentences.zh: 我一直在走访学校，我认为这种草根教师发起的人工智能公民教育运动，远比我们参观的那一所学校的一个班级要大得多。

sentences.en: The fact that teachers around the country want to help students learn to ask deep questions about whether they want a technology-driven future.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的老师都想帮助学生学会提出深刻的问题，思考他们是否想要一个由技术驱动的未来。

sentences.en: How they want AI tools to fit into their lives, or maybe they don't want to use AI at all, is a reflection of this broader questioning of the role of big tech power in society.
sentences.zh: 他们希望人工智能工具如何融入他们的生活，或者他们是否根本不想使用人工智能，这反映了对大型科技公司在社会中权力的更广泛质疑。

sentences.en: Students are not buying the idea that an AI-driven future is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 学生们并不买账“人工智能驱动的未来是不可避免的”这一观点。

sentences.en: Natasha Singer, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎·辛格，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Rachel, thank you for having me.

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Trump administration announced plans to move two major functions of the Education Department to other parts of the government, the White House's most aggressive moves yet
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府宣布计划将教育部两个主要职能部门转移到政府的其他部门，这是白宫迄今为止最激进的举措，

sentences.en: to dismantle an agency that it has pledged to dissolve.
sentences.zh: 旨在拆解一个它承诺要解散的机构。

sentences.en: The changes move programs for disabled students into the Department of Health and Human Services and the enforcement of civil rights laws in schools to the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 这些变动将残疾学生项目移交给卫生与公众服务部，并将学校民权法的执行移交给司法部。

sentences.en: The moves are expected to be immediately challenged in court.
sentences.zh: 预计这些举措将立即在法庭上受到挑战。

sentences.en: And federal prosecutors on Tuesday unsealed conspiracy, assault, and other charges against 15 people accused of violently impeding immigration enforcement officers in Minneapolis
sentences.zh: 周二，联邦检察官解封了对 15 人的指控，他们被控在明尼阿波利斯暴力阻挠移民执法人员，罪名包括共谋、袭击等，

sentences.en: during an immigration crackdown this year.
sentences.zh: 事件发生在今年的一次移民打击行动期间。

sentences.en: Minnesota's top federal prosecutor, Daniel Rosen, said the defendants were members of two Minneapolis-based groups connected with the far-left movement, Antifa.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州最高联邦检察官丹尼尔·罗森表示，被告是与极左运动“安提法”有关的两个明尼阿波利斯团体的成员。

sentences.en: Since the immigration crackdown began late last year, prosecutors have struggled to sustain similar criminal charges against ICE protesters,
sentences.zh: 自去年年底移民打击行动开始以来，检察官一直难以对移民及海关执法局（ICE）的抗议者维持类似的刑事指控，

sentences.en: with judges often questioning the government's underlying evidence.
sentences.zh: 法官经常质疑政府的基础证据。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由戴安娜·韦恩、莱克西·迪奥、阿德里安·赫斯特和安娜·福利制作。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 创作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢胡安·阿雷东多。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台受到严密控制的机器一样运作，

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。
